title: Flags Are Read-Only
description: A new admin assumes there must be a toggle switch in the console to flip feature flags at runtime. There isn't — they're environment configuration, not database rows. Confirm the API doesn't expose a write path that would contradict that.
successCondition: GET /api/admin/feature-flags succeeds with 200. PUT, PATCH, POST, and DELETE to /api/admin/feature-flags (with a valid admin token) each return 404 — there is no route registered for any of those methods on this path.
hints: Fastify returns 404, not 405, for a path with no matching route+method registered — that's the exact signal you're checking for.
docs/api/admin.md explicitly says flags are toggled per environment via env vars, with no runtime PUT.
